description: The Architect runs a maintenance drone through the deep east tunnels, and it has started logging things it shouldn't: the Watch's marks, the Watch's door. Go down into the deep, put the drone down, and the Long Watch will call you one of their own.
name: Ghost in the Works

objectives.desc: Destroy the Architect's maintenance drone in the deep east tunnels (near the Machine Sump).
emotes: {who} sets themselves against the drone's sweeping amber eye.
{who} drives another blow into the drone's chassis.
